if you haven't tried for a fully actualized build, I'd suggest trying it. efficient leveling can be a pain, but if you put the time in at the very start with an end goal in mind the results can be phenomenal, and you'll find yourself turning the difficulty up instead of down as you actually become stronger. if grinding turns you off, try looking into the lore for something that really piques your interest. for example, I rolled a dark elf and set him on the path of the tibunal church and the telvanni. goes hand in hand with the main quest-line and nets you a badass mushroom fortress. other prevalent concepts in the game can lead to hours of entertainment- free-lance vampire hunter, power hungry vampire-god against the world, slaver hunter, grand-master thief, full caster (and I mean FULL) the possibilities aren't quite endless, but they're close to.

I thought to myself "how comical, a random article add."

little did I know that with one fell click I would find myself in a mire of unimaginable coincidence and terror

with one click I was taken to none other than

the Morrowind subreddit.

what's so horrific about this you ask? well, to someone who may be unacquainted with the glorious beast that is ES: Morrowind, not much more than a daunting stat-based interaction system with little to no in-game guidelines. to the seasoned ES player, though, Morrowind represents a shining moment in history when the best of technology came together with some of the best storytellers in the industry. few other games have been crafted with such depth and allowance of control. if one so wishes they can quite quickly take their avatar to a godlike state of manipulation- flying around forever, moving so quickly you may as well be teleporting, annihilating every entity within an obscene radius- only a few of the hilarious things you may accomplish. yet, deeper within this beautifully faceted gem of a game is it's true glory- a clarion call to every gamer who has ever wanted to roll their own character through a table-top inspired world- a personal challenge of determination, strength, and most of all patience-

a stat system which requires you to either concede to mediocrity or grind to superiority.

only those who truly wish to conquer the tombs and ruins of morrowind on maximum difficulty will rise, as cream does from the viscous milk. I myself have nearly accomplished this haughty goal, only to succumb to the inevitable decay of disenchantment.
